items.body:
<details open>

spec + model: refactor DFlash based speculative decoding methods  (#32016)

* dflash : move the DSpark markov head and backbone graphs to dspark.cpp

Move-only: build_dspark_markov_head, graph_dsv4, graph_dsv41 and
graph_mistral_large4 move verbatim. build_inp_target_features and
build_dspark_markov_head become static members of llama_model_dflash so
both files can use them.

* dflash : detect the head and the backbone once, split the loaders per file

load_arch_hparams sets llama_model_dflash::variant (DFlash, DFlash2,
DSpark, LiliCorr) and ::backbone (base, DSV4, DSV4.1, Mistral Large 4).
The head, backbone and base layer loaders become member helpers in
dflash.cpp, dflash2.cpp, lilicorr.cpp and dspark.cpp. build_arch_graph
dispatches on the backbone.

The DFlash2 and LiliCorr loaders create the DFlash2 conv tensors through
a helper in dflash2.cpp, right after their head tensors instead of in
the base layer loop; the other tensors keep their creation order. The
DFlash2 loader drops its copy of the conv group size check, which master
never reached.

* dflash : share the injection input, token embeddings and lm head lookups

build_inject_inp (target features + fc + encoder norm), get_tok_embd and
get_lm_head replace the copies in the base, DSV4, DSV4.1 and Mistral
Large 4 graphs. build_inp_target_features is file-static again.

* dflash : split the DFlash decoder into a graph per head

graph_base creates the shared inputs and provides build_inject,
build_inp_tokens, build_layers and build_logits. graph_dflash
(dflash.cpp), graph_dflash2 (dflash2.cpp), graph_dspark (dspark.cpp) and
graph_lilicorr (lilicorr.cpp) assemble them and add their head; the
selector, scorer and markov head builders move to the file of their
